rules.alternatives: The 30 contact hours are one of eight continuing-competence options in 21 NCAC 36 .0232(b); the nurse attests to one option per renewal cycle. Instead of 30 contact hours the nurse may choose: national certification/recertification in the practice role; a board-approved refresher course; 2 semester hours of post-licensure nursing education; or 15 contact hours plus one of: a nursing project as (co-)principal investigator, a published nursing article/book/chapter, ≥5 contact hours of presentations taught, or 640 hours of active practice in the last 2 years.
rules.audit_note: Licensees are audited at renewal/reinstatement; proof due by the last day of the renewal month; keep documentation 3 years.
rules.notes: North Carolina has no flat CE-hour rule: at each renewal the nurse picks one continuing-competence learning option, and 30 contact hours related to the nurse's practice is the option stated purely in hours. Biennial renewal by the last day of the birth month. Each renewal also needs a self-assessment of practice and a learning plan. Active-duty military may be exempt.
